source_contract.cache: Inherited auto cache wrapper recovers before update; played misses capture whole input; paused misses cache retained output, initially source noone=-4. Animated updates scheduling on an actual miss only.
source_contract.cache_array: Start<0 maps to0, otherwise Start-1; Stop<0 maps toTOTAL_FRAMES. Invalid range uses stop<start, so equality is not invalid but cannot capture. Only played in-range observations capture. Capture every observed frame regardless Step; Step selects published positions with -1 for absent frames. Other observations retain exact previous output.
source_contract.metadata: Explicit attri.serialize bool, attri.cache_group string list and top-level cache string are roundtripped without synthetic absent fields. Constructor defaults serialize=true, empty group.
source_contract.surface_cloning: Native snapshots preserve finite bounded CPU surface formats and recursive input shape. No device handle identity, live GPU surface alias or licensed GPU clone parity claim.

native_profile.observation: Optional by-value SourceCachePlaybackObservation with explicit Playing, ObservedFrame or NativePlayedPrefix and SynchronousProducer attestation. RigidPlaying is independent.
native_profile.observed_frame: Capture only actual observations. Pure data seeks directly; mixed noncontiguous nonzero seeks diagnose missing recorded scheduler. Same-clock Playing refresh retains current latest cache output/history and restores other frame-start journals. Negative observed clocks bypass positive cache hits and never write negative slots. Playing Cache with an active producer publishes its current input; paused Cache retains its prior output. Cache Array uses the signed fractional range, including the missing -1 slot when Start frame is zero. Source cache-size checks still run before negative storage is skipped.
native_profile.played_prefix: Caller explicitly chooses Playing=true for each admitted native prefix frame. Seeks rebuild latest-output observation from constructor while retaining frame captures. Fresh seeks create the bounded played prefix.
native_profile.ownership: DataReplay tagged node/processor rows own latest output separately from sorted frame snapshots. Preserve history across authored control revisions/restart; remove/type-change retires rows. Whole owner Clear resets them. PB retains observation by value, never caller pointers.
native_profile.storage: Frame snapshots use integer slots; fractional pure frame-cache observations can select containing slots without inventing captures. Timeline storage is capped at4094 frames plus private tag/output records, array selections4096; whole evaluation byte/work limits apply with generation overlap charged.
native_profile.saved_loading: Bounded sparse and nested saved surfaces load through explicit byte-layout receipts tied to exact saved text. Native constructor loads are atomic and owned by hosts, Pixel Builder and export sessions; layout rebinding resets derived host history. This does not reproduce source incremental loading scheduling.
native_profile.selected_clear: CapturedFeedbackHost ClearSourceCache handles selected Cache, Cache Array and Cache Results without author edits or playback restart. Frame-cache Clear suppresses constructor reload and preserves source Serialize/loading/appending gates. Admitted frame-cache group enabling reactivates recorded members and force-clears frames; nonempty groups require project observations and initialized group ownership.
native_profile.unsupported: Mixed noncontiguous nonzero ObservedFrame seeks require a recorded scheduler or explicit NativePlayedPrefix. Feedback bindings, fixed simulation steps and surface-cache replay reject fractional clocks; negative NativePlayedPrefix and other stateful replay clocks remain unsupported; frame-cache ObservedFrame follows the explicit signed-clock behavior above. Freed GPU-handle identity and licensed source scheduler parity remain unverified.
native_profile.validation: docs/pixel-composer-m0/native-validation-2026-10-05.json saved_frame_cache_validation records joined release-tests acceptance for saved loading, immutable replay and retained host/export ownership. The receipt explicitly excludes live Studio and source incremental loading scheduling; current selected-Clear/group changes still require joined acceptance.
